latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at master -->

## What's Changed
### Key Changes
* Add DP `MatchSizeWith` to `PackIcon` by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4042
* Add MaterialDesign toolbar toggle button style by @Keboo in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4053
* Allow for additional content in NavigationRail-bar by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4060
* feat(AutoSuggestBox): add ShowSuggestionsOnFocus property by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4077
* Remove explicit Win32 SetFocus call when opening DialogHost by @Keboo in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4078
* Allow triple left click on a  TextBox to select all text by @JLdgu in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4081
* Allow for waiting for DialogHost animations. by @Keboo in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4083
* feat(DrawerHost): add CornerRadius property by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4096
* feat(NumericUpDown): add `DoubleUpDown` and `LongUpDown` controls by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4106
* feat(TabControl): Allow changing NavigationButtonStyle by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4109
### Breaking Changes
* Position DatePicker and TimePicker popups below input fields by @Keboo in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4052
* fix(DataGrid): Center DataGridCell-Content by default by @corvinsz in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4087

## New Contributors
* @SafuanA made their first contribution in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4075
* @Markot4 made their first contribution in https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/pull/4085

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MaterialDesignInXAML/MaterialDesignInXamlToolkit/compare/v5.3.2...v5.4.0
